flashcard_questions.q: Compulsory prayer performed five times daily by Muslims, involving specific movements, recitations and conditions.
Ritual washing (ablution) carried out before prayer, involving washing the hands, face, arms, head and feet in a set order.
A dry form of ritual purification using clean earth or sand, permitted when water is unavailable.

flashcard_questions.a: The cube-shaped building in Makkah that Muslims face during prayer, believed to have been built by Ibrahim and Isma’il.
A niche in the wall of a mosque indicating the direction of Makkah for prayer.
